fusions.name: Closing Tread
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Settling Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 15 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Stalk
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
